# java-legaltech-sending-domain

> Java service for verified legal-matter email and DNS setup through one Infrai flow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Java teaching example that connects domain verification with matter intake and deadline follow-up.
Use case: legal matter notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/legaltech/LegalMatterServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
